calculator.title: Compound Interest Calculator
calculator.subtitle: See how compound interest works. A learning tool to understand potential growth – not a guarantee.

intro.title: What does this calculator show?
intro.p1: The calculator shows how much money you theoretically could have after one year, given a fixed daily return. This is called "compound interest" – return on return.
intro.p2: Remember: In reality, returns are never even. Some days go up, others down. Use this as a learning tool, not as an expected result.

disclaimer.title: Important to remember
disclaimer.text: This is a theoretical calculation. In reality the market fluctuates, and returns are never guaranteed. You can lose money trading. Use the calculator as a learning tool, not as an expected result.

faqs.a: Klarpakke University is a Norwegian crypto education platform. We offer courses, simulators, paper trading and quizzes – everything to teach you trading safely. All trading is 100% simulated, so you can practice without risking real money.

faqs.q: What plans exist and what do they cost?
faqs.a: We have four plans: Free (0 kr) gives you a taste. Basic (199 kr/mo) includes all basic courses. Complete (399 kr/mo) is our most popular plan with everything in Basic plus advanced courses, certificate and webinars. Pro (999 kr/mo) gives extra resources and priority support.

No! Everything at Klarpakke University is simulated. When you use paper trading or the simulator, you trade with virtual money. You cannot lose real money here. This is a safe place to learn before potentially using real money with an external broker.
You can cancel anytime from your account settings. You keep access until the end of the paid period. There is no lock-in period – you decide how long you want to stay.

faqs.q: How do I start with paper trading?
faqs.a: Sign up for free, and you automatically get 1,000,000 kr virtual capital. Go to the Paper Trading page, select a cryptocurrency, and press buy to make your first trade. It is completely risk-free!

faqs.q: What do I learn in the courses?
faqs.a: Basic courses cover what crypto is, how trading works, and basic risk management. Advanced courses go deeper into technical analysis, strategies and trading psychology. Everything is in plain language.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.heroDescription: My journey from losing everything to cracking the code – and how you can do the same.

part1.title: The Expensive Lesson
part1.content: Six years ago, I lost 65,000 NOK on crypto. It was a brutal wake-up call. I blindly trusted "experts" who promised the moon but delivered nothing but fees and empty promises. Money drained away, and I was left with a costly but valuable lesson: Trust no one but yourself.

part2.title: The Turning Point
part2.content: Two years ago, I took control. I immersed myself in advanced programming and AI, developing my own auto-trader. I started small, tested, failed, and adjusted. As the algorithms began delivering consistent results, I gained the confidence to scale up.

part3.title: From Gambling to Strategy
part3.content: I quit betting, the lottery, and traditional savings accounts. All my focus went into the system. When the results exceeded my expectations, I started sharing the tool with friends and family. The response was overwhelming. It became clear that there was a need for an honest, transparent gateway to crypto for everyday people.

part4.title: Klarpakke is Born
part4.content: I gathered a team of experts, developers, and traders with a simple goal: To make advanced technology accessible to everyone, without hidden agendas. Thus, Klarpakke University was born – a place where knowledge and integrity come first.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.noPyramidDesc: No pyramid schemes, no recruiting, no secrets. We believe honesty is the only sustainable policy.
philosophy.educationFirstDesc: We give you the tools, but you're in the driver's seat. Our auto-trader does the heavy lifting, but your understanding ensures success.
philosophy.patienceDesc: Crypto isn't a get-rich-quick scheme. We aim for steady, sustainable growth – 0.2% daily profit beats 100% risk. That's the power of compound interest.
